shipped_originals.title_o: Significant Linkage of Parkinson Disease to Chromosome 2q36-37
shipped_originals.authors_o: Pankratz; Nichols; Uniacke; Halter; Rudolph; Shults; Conneally; Foroud

old_target.evidence_quote: Recently, significant linkage has been reported to a 39.5 cM region on the long arm of chromosome 2 (2q36-37; PARK11) in North American Parkinson families under an autosomal dominant model of inheritance. We have performed a replication study to confirm linkage to this region in a European population.
old_target.outcome_quote: Linkage analysis in 153 individuals from 45 European families with a strong family history of PD did not show any significant LOD score in this region. Therefore, PARK11 does not seem to play a major role for familial PD in the European population.
old_target.outcome_reasoning: Explicit replication of previously significant linkage yields no linkage and an overall negative conclusion.
